title: Compute the kernel of a graded polynomial-module map

source.citation: Janko Boehm, Wolfram Decker, and Frank-Olaf Schreyer, Commutative Algebra and Algebraic Geometry using OSCAR, arXiv:2404.12085

translation.notes: The source's rank-three to rank-two polynomial-module map is entered independently. Noether computes its kernel, verifies its module Groebner basis, and proves equality with the displayed principal syzygy. No source transcript is redistributed.
